description: This PHP source file defines a class 'BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber' that subscribes to specific events related to employee data management, such as employee purging and deletion. It performs actions to adjust like and comment counts on shares and comments within a Buzz module of the OrangeHRM system when these events occur.

classes.name: BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for employee-related events and adjusts like and comment counts on shares and comments within the Buzz module accordingly.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping specific events to handler methods within the class.

methods.name: onEmployeePurgingEnd
methods.description: Handles the event when an employee is being purged; adjusts like and comment counts accordingly.

methods.name: onEmployeesDeleted
methods.description: Handles the event when employees are deleted; updates like and comment counts accordingly.
